articles.title: A Spider That Dresses Like a Killer Fungus: First-of-Its-Kind Mimicry Found in the Amazon
articles.summary: In Ecuador's Amazon, a spider mimics a parasitic fungus that infects spiders — the first known case of its kind. Its pale, spiky body and motionless pose fooled scientists who initially thought it was a mushroom.

articles.title: Warframe's 'Constellations' Update Splits Reality: Stalker's Twin Sons Arrive from Parallel Timelines
articles.summary: Warframe's latest update delivers a narrative shocker: Stalker's child, named by players as either Sirius or Orion, now exists as twins from alternate realities. The update also revives Railjack space combat, setting the stage for a cosmic-scale story.

articles.title: Your Body Might Know How to Regrow Limbs — Scientists Just Found the 'On' Switch
articles.summary: A Texas A&M team used a two-step growth factor treatment to regrow bone and joint tissue in mammals, without adding stem cells. The study suggests regenerative abilities are hidden, not absent, in humans.
